runs.text: The kiosk needs these jobs. Place each one in the centre that only computes or in the edge that touches the world.
The trap is the date: deciding whether a product has expired is pure if today's date arrives as data. Finding it out touches the world, because each day gives a different result.
Compute the VAT of a price.
Decide whether a product has expired, given its date and today's date.
Ask the cashier how many products the customer has.
